maniacmod.settings.title: Game Settings
maniacmod.settings.key.game.minPlayers.d: How many players are needed to start a match.
maniacmod.settings.key.game.debugMode.de: Lets a single player start a match without it ending when one side hits zero.
maniacmod.settings.key.game.debugRole.de: Who the single player becomes in debug mode.
maniacmod.settings.key.game.roleRevealSe: How many seconds the role-reveal screen lasts at match start.
maniacmod.settings.key.game.endingSecond: How many seconds the match-end screen lasts.
maniacmod.settings.key.world.gameTimeTic: Minecraft time-of-day ticks kept during an active game.
maniacmod.settings.key.world.maintainGam: Whether to hold the time of day fixed for the whole match instead of letting it run.
maniacmod.settings.key.world.weatherEven: Whether rain and thunderstorms can start on their own during a game.
Chance a weather event starts after each random interval.
maniacmod.settings.key.world.weatherTarg: Largest share of the active game that weather may occupy in total.
maniacmod.settings.key.world.weatherMinI: Shortest pause between weather-event attempts, in seconds.
maniacmod.settings.key.world.weatherMaxI: Longest pause between weather-event attempts, in seconds.
maniacmod.settings.key.world.weatherMinD: Shortest possible duration of one weather event, in seconds.
maniacmod.settings.key.world.weatherMaxD: Longest possible duration of one weather event, in seconds.
maniacmod.settings.key.world.weatherThun: Chance that a weather event is a thunderstorm rather than plain rain.
maniacmod.settings.key.map.sizeBlocks.de: Size of the playable map, in blocks.
maniacmod.settings.key.map.minSurvivorTo: Minimum allowed distance from a survivor spawn point to the maniac, in blocks.
Minimum allowed distance between two survivor spawn points, in blocks.
maniacmod.settings.key.map.itemPointEnga: Share of map points that become item-spawn locations.
maniacmod.settings.key.map.relaxationSte: How strongly spawn points push apart from each other in one relaxation pass.
maniacmod.settings.key.map.maxRelaxation: Maximum number of spawn-point relaxation passes during map generation.
maniacmod.settings.key.generators.genera: How many generators must be repaired to unlock the escape.
maniacmod.settings.key.generators.bonusG: How many extra, non-required generators spawn for each maniac in the match.
maniacmod.settings.key.generators.miniga: Chance per tick of held repair that a minigame triggers for the player.
maniacmod.settings.key.generators.target: How many hits on the target are needed to clear the Target minigame.
Speed of the Target minigame's moving cursor, in bar-widths per second.
Width of the hit zone around the fixed target, as a fraction of the bar.
maniacmod.settings.key.generators.wireMi: Time limit for the whole Wires minigame (all 4 wires together), in ticks.
maniacmod.settings.key.generators.fuelRe: How many percent of fuel must be poured into a generator beyond repair.
maniacmod.settings.key.generators.highli: How many ticks the generator highlight lasts after using the ability.
maniacmod.settings.key.generators.failFl: How many ticks the generator's red flash lasts after a failed minigame.
maniacmod.settings.key.generators.miniga: How many percent of repair progress is lost on a failed minigame.
maniacmod.settings.key.generators.repair: How many seconds of holding repair are needed to go from 0% to 100% on a stage.
maniacmod.settings.key.generators.fuelPe: How many percent of fuel per second move from the canister into the generator. The same amount is drained from the canister charge.
maniacmod.settings.key.generators.screwd: How much faster repair goes with a screwdriver.
How much a screwdriver reduces the chance of a minigame during repair.
maniacmod.settings.key.generators.stageO: The order in which repair and fueling happen.
maniacmod.settings.key.survivors.invento: How many hotbar slots a survivor sees.
maniacmod.settings.key.survivors.flashli: Cooldown between flashlight uses, in ticks.
maniacmod.settings.key.survivors.rescueT: How many ticks it takes to pick up a downed survivor.
maniacmod.settings.key.survivors.rescueH: How much faster the rescue goes when another player helps.
maniacmod.settings.key.survivors.stamina: How much stamina is spent per tick while sprinting.
How much stamina regenerates per tick while not sprinting.
maniacmod.settings.key.survivors.fallKno: Fall height, in blocks, after which a survivor is knocked down.
maniacmod.settings.key.survivors.legBrea: Fall height, in blocks, from which the leg can break. Below it the survivor is only knocked down.
Leg break chance at min height
Chance to break the leg exactly at the min height (0-1).
From this height the break chance is at its maximum and stops growing. It rises smoothly between min height and this one.
Leg break chance at max height
Chance to break the leg at the max height and above (0-1).
maniacmod.settings.key.survivors.heartbe: Distance, in blocks, at which a survivor hears the maniac's heartbeat.
maniacmod.settings.key.maniac.attackRang: The maniac's attack range, in blocks.
maniacmod.settings.key.maniac.attackCool: Cooldown between the maniac's attacks, in ticks.
maniacmod.settings.key.maniac.attackDama: How much damage the maniac's attack deals.
maniacmod.settings.key.maniac.trapPlaceC: Cooldown between placing traps, in ticks.
maniacmod.settings.key.maniac.trapMinDis: Minimum allowed distance from a player at which a trap can be placed.
How the player who becomes the maniac is chosen.
How the maniac's archetype (character) is chosen.
Maniac id for FIXED mode; empty means random.
How many seconds are given to choose the maniac before the mod decides on its own.
Whether to show the intro scene before the match starts.
maniacmod.settings.key.loot.pickupRangeB: Distance, in blocks, from which a ground item can be picked up.
maniacmod.settings.key.loot.dropPickupDe: Ticks before an item you just threw (Q) can be picked up again. 0 = immediately.
maniacmod.settings.key.inventory.bypassC: Whether creative/spectator players are exempt from slot limits and hotbar hiding.
maniacmod.settings.key.generators.minGen: Smallest distance in blocks between two generators of one match. Relaxed step by step if the map cannot satisfy it.
Smallest distance in blocks from a generator to the maniac start point.
maniacmod.settings.key.generators.repair: Repair pauses when the player is farther than this many blocks from the generator.
How far (degrees) the player may look away from the generator while repairing. 180 disables the check.
maniacmod.settings.key.generators.target: Network delay (ms) the server forgives when verifying the slider position.
